item.title: Casey-Fink Surveys: Assess Nurse Readiness to Practice, Retention, and Role Transition
item.description: Dr. Kathy Casey and Dr. Regina Fink have collaborated for over three decades to improve the role transition experiences of nurses, especially nursing students to practice. The Casey-Fink surveys are designed to evaluate transition-to-practice nursing program outcomes, measure graduate nurses' experiences, assess their readiness for practice, and identify factors that affect nurse retention.
